name: Computer Organization & Architecture
short_description: CPU datapath, instruction pipelines, memory hierarchy, cache coherence, and RISC/CISC.
description: Instruction set architectures (RISC-V/MIPS), arithmetic logic units, single-cycle and pipelined datapath design, pipeline hazards, branch prediction, and multi-level cache hierarchies.

courses.title: Computer Organization & Architecture
courses.description: Von Neumann architecture, pipelined processors, memory caches, and bus interconnects.

modules.title: Computer System Fundamentals
modules.description: The stored-program computer and how its performance is measured.

topics.title: Von Neumann Architecture & Performance Metrics
topics.summary: Stored-program machines, CPU time, CPI, MIPS, and Amdahl's law.

modules.title: Computer Arithmetic
modules.description: How hardware adds, multiplies, and represents real numbers.

topics.title: Integer Arithmetic & IEEE 754 Floating Point
topics.summary: Two's complement adders, Booth multiplication, and floating-point representation.

modules.title: Instruction Set Architecture
modules.description: RISC vs CISC, machine instruction formats, addressing modes, and register files.

topics.title: RISC vs CISC & Instruction Formats
topics.summary: Load-store architectures vs memory-operand CISC instructions.

topics.title: Addressing Modes
topics.summary: Immediate, register, direct, indirect, indexed, and relative addressing with effective-address calculations.

topics.title: Instruction Cycle & Assembly Language
topics.summary: The fetch-decode-execute cycle and reading simple RISC assembly programs.

modules.title: Datapath & Control Unit
modules.description: How the processor's datapath executes instructions and how control signals are generated.

topics.title: Datapath & Register Organization
topics.summary: Registers, the ALU, buses, and how a single-cycle datapath executes instructions.

topics.title: Hardwired vs Microprogrammed Control
topics.summary: Generating control signals with logic or with microcode, and the trade-offs.

modules.title: Pipelining & Hazards
modules.description: 5-stage classic pipeline (IF, ID, EX, MEM, WB), structural, data, and control hazards.

topics.title: Pipelining Fundamentals & Speedup
topics.summary: Pipeline stages, throughput versus latency, and ideal and real speedup.

topics.title: Pipeline Hazards & Forwarding
topics.summary: RAW dependencies, pipeline stalls, forwarding paths, and branch delay slots.

modules.title: Memory Hierarchy & Caches
modules.description: Direct-mapped, set-associative caches, cache hit/miss penalties, and write policies.

topics.title: Cache Associativity & Mapping
topics.summary: Tag, index, offset bit calculation and replacement policies (LRU).

topics.title: Cache Performance & AMAT
topics.summary: Hit rates, miss penalties, average memory access time, and multilevel caches.

topics.title: Main Memory, Virtual Memory & TLBs
topics.summary: DRAM organisation, address-translation hardware, and the translation lookaside buffer.

modules.title: Input/Output Organization
modules.description: How the processor exchanges data with devices.

topics.title: I/O Techniques: Polling, Interrupts & DMA
topics.summary: Programmed I/O, interrupt-driven I/O, and DMA transfers compared.

modules.title: Parallel Processing
modules.description: Doing more work per cycle: instruction-level, thread-level, and multicore parallelism.

topics.title: Instruction-Level & Multicore Parallelism
topics.summary: Superscalar issue, Flynn's taxonomy, multicore processors, and cache coherence.
